scope: Read existing JSON and compute signed integer arithmetic in the tool runtime. No shell command, external program, test, native/OS probe, workload, link or system change was started. Existing final-review.md/json remain unchanged.

method.definition: difference = Job CPU 100ns ticks minus sum of CPU 100ns ticks for all retained members in the same final raw response
method.case_set: All 58 unique IDs in reconciliation JSON matched the final author report and all 58 .stdout.jsonl raw responses
method.raw_audit: Independently recomputed user and kernel sums and matched every provided difference; did not rerun the qualification workload

interpretation.direction: All nonzero differences are negative: retained member CPU sums exceed recorded Job CPU in that component. This is an observed discrepancy, not proof of the internal cause or of missing CPU/members.
interpretation.scale: Maximum absolute user difference 62.5ms; kernel 62.5ms; combined within one case 93.75ms. All nonzero values in this data set are multiples of 15.625ms. No OS timing or accounting implementation is inferred from that pattern.
interpretation.exact_equality_claim: REJECTED: 24/58 cases are unequal in at least one component; no claim of exact reconciliation or definitively absent accounting gap is supported.
interpretation.membership: All 58 raw responses record root_exit_observed=true, all observed retained members exited=true, history_complete_observed=true, and assigned count == pinned count == members.length. These observations do not resolve the accounting discrepancy or authorize release.
interpretation.budget_conclusion: The discrepancy does not explain the observed multi-second strict-budget overshoot. In the cited 80ms-budget case, both Job and member user CPU are 4781.25ms with zero discrepancy; all observed nonzero differences make member sums larger than Job readings. Exact enforcement/overshoot timing remains unqualified.

prior_freeze_evidence: The prior 4825 report of 57 FAIL / 1 PASS and its retained regression failures remain unchanged. This addendum cites the later 3f4c author report (56 FAIL / 2 PASS) and audits arithmetic only.
limits: Observed equality in 34 cases does not establish that all CPU sources are always captured or future samples will reconcile.
Signaled handles and complete historical counts concern retained-member lifecycle observation, not the origin or correctness of Job-versus-member CPU accounting.
No deterministic cause is assigned to OS internals, timer cadence, sampling order, load or missing processes.
The final cumulative CPU qualification remains FAIL; hard production admission gates and no-release status remain required.
No final full-suite, restart, cross-account boundary, genuine ExitProof or production release qualification is added.
